headline: AI Backlash and Regulatory Pressures Threaten Anthropic IPO Timing
summary: Growing public and political backlash against artificial intelligence could threaten the timing of Anthropic's potential initial public offering, according to prospective investors.
why: Regulatory and political scrutiny of artificial intelligence technology can alter capital market entry timelines for high-profile AI startups.

impacts.name: Artificial Intelligence
impacts.why: Regulatory pushback creates delays and uncertainty for upcoming technology sector public offerings.
